events.title: State Senate & House District Karaoke Night
events.description: A community karaoke night bringing together neighbors from Minnesota Senate District 33 and House Districts 33A and 33B. Volunteers, residents, and friends are welcome. Light program notes on local races; the evening is social first. Great mock event for visibility and volunteer recruitment.
events.audience: Volunteers, residents, families (all ages welcome with a parent/guardian)
events.rsvpHint: Sign up on the volunteer schedule board or contact the field team.

events.title: Saturday Neighborhood Canvass
events.description: Door knocking and literature in priority precincts. New volunteers pair with a captain. Training takes about 15 minutes.
events.rsvpHint: Claim a shift on the Volunteer Schedule board.
